page.layout: One printed page: running head "SUMMARIA" at top centre; below, one column of numbered list entries (23 to 39), each entry a hanging-indented line group; a catchword-like partial line "39. Codicea" at lower right is part of the list; digitiser watermark at bottom right left out.

main_text.l: cyrana scripti, quando hæc habita & quot ejus Canones.
23. Secundi in Neocæsariensi, ejusque tempus & numerus canonum.
24. Laodicena synodus, ejusque tempus, & numerus canonum.
26. Nicæna synodus prima & Oecumenica, ejusq; canonum numerus.
27. Cur Nicæni canones in codice canonum Catholicæ Ecclesiæ, primo loco positi.
29. Concilium Constantinopolitanum primum, Oecumenicum secundū & ejus canonū numerus.
30. Ephesina synodus Oecumenica tertia, & numerus canonum.
31. Concilii Calchedonensis Oecumenici quarti canones XXIX. claudunt codicem canonum Ecclesiæ universæ.
32. Canones conciliorum antiquiores, sed non relati in codicem canonum; velut concilij Eliberini.
36. Quot canones in principio habuerit codex canonū.
38. Ecclesia post tempora Nicæni concilij scriptura & canonibus cœpit regi.

page.notes: Scan is partly faint at the lower right; "39. Codicea" is cut off at the edge of the scan and may continue. Several words in the entries, notably the underlined initial words of entries 28, 32, 34–36, are set in italic type. Stray marks and specks omitted.
